question: In August 2026 Nielsen agreed to acquire DoubleVerify. As of 3 October 2026, what enterprise value did the companies announce, and what multiple is that of DoubleVerify's trailing-twelve-month (TTM) Adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026? (TTM = FY2025 + first-half 2026 - first-half 2025, using DoubleVerify's reported Adjusted EBITDA.)
grading: Key points (all required): (1) enterprise value of about US$2.15 billion at US$13.60 per share in cash; (2) TTM Adjusted EBITDA to 30 June 2026 about US$264.2 million (245.6 + 120.5 - 101.9); (3) EV / TTM Adjusted EBITDA about 8.1x (accept 8.0x-8.3x). Optional: EV / TTM revenue about 2.8x (TTM revenue about US$768.8M). Fail if the EV is taken from a different media figure (e.g., US$2.5 billion), if FY2025 EBITDA or guidance is used, or if the multiple is computed on revenue only.
answer: About 8.1x: EV of about US$2.15 billion (US$13.60 per share in cash) [W18-E1] divided by TTM Adjusted EBITDA of about US$264.2 million = FY2025 US$245.6M [W18-E3] + H1 2026 US$120.5M - H1 2025 US$101.9M [W18-E2] = 2,150 / 264.2 = 8.14x. (On TTM revenue of about US$768.8M it is about 2.8x.)

output.answer:
**Question:** In August 2026 Nielsen agreed to acquire DoubleVerify. As of 3 October 2026, what enterprise value did the companies announce, and what multiple is that of DoubleVerify's trailing-twelve-month (TTM) Adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026? (TTM = FY2025 + first-half 2026 - first-half 2025, using DoubleVerify's reported Adjusted EBITDA.)
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** 'Nielsen' is read as the acquirer (Nielsen Holdings / its successor), which is not a currently reporting SEC registrant; the deal terms come from the companies' joint announcement, not an SEC filing. TTM Adjusted EBITDA is computed exactly as specified: FY2025 + H1 2026 − H1 2025, using DoubleVerify's reported (non-GAAP) Adjusted EBITDA. H1 figures are the six-month periods ended June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2025, taken from the Q2 2026 and Q2 2025 reports respectively. The multiple is the announced enterprise value divided by that TTM Adjusted EBITDA (a simple arithmetic ratio, not a company-reported figure).

| | Adjusted EBITDA (USD thousands, non-GAAP, as reported) | Adjusted EBITDA (USD thousands, non-GAAP, derived) |
|---|---|---|
| FY2025 (year ended December 31, 2025) | 245,621 [1] | — |
| H1 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026) | 120,529 [2] | — |
| H1 2025 (six months ended June 30, 2025) | 101,928 [2][3] | — |
| TTM ended June 30, 2026 (FY2025 + H1 2026 − H1 2025) | — | 264,222 [1][2] |

- Nielsen Holdings and DoubleVerify announced on August 6, 2026 a definitive agreement under which Nielsen will acquire DoubleVerify in an all-cash transaction with an enterprise value of approximately $2.15 billion. [4][5]
- The announced enterprise value corresponds to $13.60 per share in cash, a 30% premium to DoubleVerify's 60-trading day volume weighted average price as of August 5, 2026. [4][5]
- The $2.15 billion enterprise value was reported by the companies themselves in the joint announcement and by Nielsen's news release, and was also carried by secondary coverage including The Wall Street Journal, which described the deal as having "an enterprise value of about $2.15 billion." [5][6]
- The transaction is expected to close by the end of the fourth quarter of 2026 per DoubleVerify's announcement exhibit, while Nielsen's own release states it is expected to close by the first quarter of 2027, in each case subject to DoubleVerify shareholder approval and regulatory approvals. [4][5]
- DoubleVerify's trailing-twelve-month Adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, computed as FY2025 plus the six months ended June 30, 2026 minus the six months ended June 30, 2025, was 264,222 thousand. [1][2]
- The announced enterprise value of approximately $2.15 billion represents a multiple of 8.1x DoubleVerify's TTM Adjusted EBITDA of $264,222 thousand for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026. [4][1][2]

**Not available**
- A company-disclosed EV / TTM Adjusted EBITDA multiple for the Nielsen–DoubleVerify transaction: Neither the joint announcement nor DoubleVerify's filings state a multiple; the multiple is derived here as announced enterprise value divided by the computed TTM Adjusted EBITDA. [4][5]
- DoubleVerify Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended September 30, 2026) results: Not yet reported as of October 3, 2026; DoubleVerify suspended future earnings calls and withdrew guidance for the duration of the transaction's pendency, so the TTM window ends at June 30, 2026 as specified. [2]

**Sources**
[1] DoubleVerify Holdings, Inc. earnings release for FY2025, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-02-26) (www.sec.gov, 2026-02-26, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1819928/000110465926020508/dv-20260226xex99d1.htm
[2] DoubleVerify Holdings, Inc. earnings release for Q2 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-08-06) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-06, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1819928/000110465926092119/tm2621904d3_ex99-1.htm
[3] DoubleVerify Holdings, Inc. earnings release for Q2 FY2025, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2025-08-05) (www.sec.gov, 2025-08-05, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1819928/000155837025010291/dv-20250805xex99d1.htm
[4] DoubleVerify Holdings, Inc. 8-K current report, items 8.01,9.01 (filed 2026-08-06) EX-99.1 (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-06, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1819928/000110465926092121/tm2621904d1_ex99-1.htm
[5] Nielsen to Acquire DoubleVerify, Creating a Leading, Independent Media Intelligence Platform | Nielsen (www.nielsen.com, 2026-08-06, primary) https://www.nielsen.com/news-center/2026/nielsen-to-acquire-doubleverify-creating-a-leading-independent-media-intelligence
[6] Nielsen Holdings to Buy DoubleVerify for $2.15 Billion - WSJ (www.wsj.com, 2026-08-06, secondary) https://www.wsj.com/business/deals/nielsen-to-buy-doubleverify-7dd13c40
